name: Lapierre
verdict: French bike brand owned by the Accell Group, which in 2022 was taken private by investment funds advised by KKR (96.90% of shares). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Chain is Lapierre -> Accell Group -> investment funds advised by KKR (KKR & Co. Inc., NYSE-listed, no state link). Caveat: Accell Group was declared bankrupt by an Amsterdam court in August 2026 and Cycles Lapierre filed for judicial reorganisation with the Dijon Commercial Court (Cycling Weekly, 13 August 2026); Lapierre's ultimate ownership is in flux and should be rechecked. No human-rights finding against Accell, KKR or Lapierre found.
